mentl/93952b8:
The wheel's fresh_ph trap reduces to: a function performing two distinct
effects collides on ev-slot 0. A perform site needs TWO indices —
ev-slot (which forwarded handler record = which effect) and op-slot (which
arm within it) — but the seed computes only op-slot, and emit_levperform
reads the handler record from a FIXED __state[8] for every effect. Uniform
op signatures mask the wrong dispatch (it type-checks by luck); differing
arity makes it visible.

bootstrap/test/repro_multi_effect_ev_slot_collision.mn (9 lines) is the
verification harness. Fix design (LEvPerform gains an ev_slot field; lower
computes effect-index-in-row; emit reads __state[8+4*ev_slot]; derive_ev_slots
returns one ev per effect; install/forward populate per-effect slots; seed
mirror) in §11. This is Koka-style evidence-vector indexing, derived from
the effect ROW.

mentl/93d152e:
Three critical fixes for WASM self-hosting bootstrap:

1. LIndex 4th field (is_tuple) — was being dropped by lowir_walk,
   causing all array indexing to compile as flat pointer arithmetic
   instead of calling list_index. Fixed in lower_ir, lowir_walk,
   lower_print, and lower.lux.

2. O(N) split — replaced per-character str_slice allocation in
   split_find with in-place byte comparison (split_match_at), and
   replaced tail-copying recursion with offset-passing (split_from).

3. Eliminated strip_imports from compile_wasm pipeline — the parser
   already creates ImportStmt nodes that checker, lowerer, and emitter
   all gracefully ignore. The split-filter-join was burning O(N²)
   memory in join() for redundant work.

architecture notes (bump allocator warnings), and all three fixes.

perennials/938198e:
The third projection reads the same shaped ground as the other two. The
sheet's plane subdivides and drapes over the surface at the figures'
own scale, vertex normals shading the slopes; every figure stands at
its footing — the elevation's number, so the projections cannot
disagree — and flat marks, rings and her benchmarks ride the draped
paper. With no span the corner post now carries the tallest measured
thing, plant or landform, its feet on its corner's ground. Walk-in
stands her on the ground the near edge actually has.

The bed lines learn the land twice over: each crown's occluder starts
from the ground under its plant, and the height field itself joins the
ray test, so a bank between the winter sun and a bed costs it the hours
a real bank would (the rules test pins exactly that). In the scene the
draped mesh casts real shadows too. The honesty line says the land is
counted only when there is one, and an unshaped yard renders and
computes exactly as before.
